//: The Aglyn app and everything it compiles: the shell, libs/mobile/*, and each plugin's src/mobile (AGL-3620). Run with `npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck`; the root `npm run typecheck` skips it because this app's packages are its own install. Strictness matches tsconfig.base.json, because the pure workspace modules the app compiles are written under it. `@tshelpers` and `@jsx` are the workspace's ambient type helpers, which the pure core modules the app reads are typed against (AGL-3622); types only, no code.
